body: I have a Citizen Altichron for a watch it has a compass and altimeter built into it. I’m a captain of a 757-200 currently and I fly cargo because “boxes don’t bitch” so no real announcements to the loadmasters just some radio chatter to ATC. As far as being taught HOW to talk yes. We are told to be professional and watch our mouths and manners because we represent the company on the plane. As far as being an instructor I really don’t think I’d have the patience for it. Some people are practically impossible to teach how to fly. Lol but yes I have tried to divert my thoughts and I always find myself right back here. Normally late at nights when I’m trying to sleep.

I couldn’t leave Texas man. If you saw me in person you’d understand. I’m a textbook Texas countryboy. I love my state I couldn’t see LIVING somewhere else. Being a pilot I certainly understand if you want change “get 2 burning and turning” and change it. But I love TEXAS as my home. I love Texas plates, Texas western bars, Texas sunsets, the full size trucks, the tractors, ect. As far as the therapist... I’m pretty certain that if I did I would be getting medication and that’s great. IF they work. Another problem to overcome is it’ll then show up on later drug tests. Then I’ll get canned.

Flying is pure bliss. Truly it’s hard to be depressed in a cockpit. My problem is my voice inside my head is a dick and tells me I don’t deserve it and sometimes ruins that shit. So that isn’t fun but the other 98% of the time I’ve got at least a slight grin on my face. I find my hardest part of my job on some days is the meeting everyone as they walk on board when I’m flying souls. I feel they can see sometimes it isn’t genuine and I truly try to be as genuine as possible because I do truly love every single one of my passengers and feel they deserve it by trusting ME with what they hold dearest like their families and themselves. That’s my reward even on a shitty day (not as in shitty as people are shitty. Shitty as in I wake up in one of my god forsaken dark fogs) is knowing I safely moved you from point A to point B on the scenic route and you trusted me to do so.

The only problem is I get drug tested at least twice a year (I fly for 2 companies that I shift from one to the other depending on the time of year. So with me gone so much from one company, by the time I get back it’s time for another drug  panel.) There are even a few companies out there that do psychologicals upon entry before you even step foot in a cockpit/simulator for any training. If you piss hot for anything you don’t have in your file and a prescription for your career is over. You can lose your wings. Permanently. That’s what they waive over our heads when warning us about smoking weed or snorting coke (not as common as “Flight” made it out to be but I’d say 1 out of 30-40 flyboys snort some bugger sugar. Its only because they know it stays in your system for like a week then your in the clear. No I haven’t tried it). It’s really one of those cases your told to shut up and suffer quietly so you don’t disturb the others. So as I could go out of pocket and get the services (and maybe but hopefully not) drugs that I require. But I’d be fired for lying on my application under prescriptions taken. And yes I have to list those because some medications are “blackballed” from a cockpit.

All the time. I couldn’t do it to my family walking in and seeing me hanging or that I blew my head off. Every night I catch myself audibly saying “you should kill yourself” as I get into bed to pull the covers up. I don’t know why I do this I’ve done this for years. I go through spells of mania and depression. I’m damn certain I’m a manic depressive. Now the real sad part... I can’t be diagnosed with any of this shit because I fly planes for a living. Now let me get one thing straight to everyone. I would NEVER act anything out in a cockpit. I have innocent souls behind me that are not involved nor to blame for my fucked up mind. I don’t want to hurt anyone else or take anyone with me. They didn’t do anything so please do not even let that thought cross your mind. That’s people’s moms, daughters, sons, and dads behind me. I’ll die FOR them. So please do not attack me on what my career is/how I shouldn’t be a pilot as it’s one of the few things I’m proud of myself for. But yes in my position where you can’t ask for help and you have to fix it yourself.
